preconditions.description: The number of towns is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of different types of goods necessary to hold a fair is between 1 and the minimum of n and 100, inclusive.
Each town produces exactly one type of goods, which is between 1 and k, inclusive.
Towns are numbered from 1 to n, and there is a road between every two towns.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of n numbers, one for each town.
Each number in the output is non-negative, representing the minimum number of coins needed to hold a fair in the corresponding town.

postconditions.expression: exists(output[i] for i in range(n) if output[i] == min(output))
postconditions.description: There exists at least one town where the minimum number of coins needed to hold a fair is achieved.

invariants.description: Each town produces a unique type of goods.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u, v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
invariants.description: There is a road between every two towns, and no road connects a town to itself.
